subject.title: fix(browser): prove post-action target continuity before adopting a tab

question: Should browser operation backends own and return their target outcome across managed Playwright, extension relay, and Chrome MCP, replacing the shared route-level resolver heuristic?
rationale: The proposed A/B choice changes the permanent identity boundary and compatibility behavior across three backends; an automated repair cannot safely choose that contract direction.

options.title: Adopt backend-owned outcomes
options.body: Have each backend return the exact acted-on or closed target outcome and remove route-level target inference; preserve renderer-swap continuity through the backend that owns the stable handle.

options.title: Accept bounded heuristic continuity
options.body: Retain the new-target and URL-cardinality rules, accepting that neither proves page identity in all multi-target browser states.

recommendation.title: Adopt backend-owned outcomes
recommendation.body: Have each backend return the exact acted-on or closed target outcome and remove route-level target inference; preserve renderer-swap continuity through the backend that owns the stable handle.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged renderer-swap recovery is the historical behavior whose replacement must remain compatible.
